messages.subject: Raed | GCC Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Kanaan,

I am sharing my profile for senior GCC mandates across industrial, infrastructure, financial-services, sovereign-linked and public-sector-facing organizations.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications. Earlier experience in regulated financial services adds cross-sector depth to my current multinational mining leadership role.

Your leadership of Egon Zehnder's Middle East business, together with your work across government entities, industrial companies, banks, private equity, sovereign wealth funds and family-owned groups in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, makes this a strong fit for confidential consideration.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director, Country Representative and VP-track roles across Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Strategic Partnerships, Regulatory Strategy and related country-facing leadership functions. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE and wider region.

I have attached a GCC-focused executive CV. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
